main_body: Steampunk lamp post: a grey domed cap, a glowing lamp housing, a thin 2px pole, and a domed base
top_band: Light grey dome highlight at rows 1-4 (L~148-158) over mid grey rows 5-7 (L=122). It is a shaded dome highlight on the left and centre only. The right column (x=11) has no lighter band.
evidence: The cap is a rounded, shaded dome that reads as a mushroom shape rather than a clear, lighter top face. At x=11 it stays a single L=122 run from row 1 to row 7. There is no front-edge line between the top and the face. The lamp housing (rows 11-17) is a flat, face-on glass panel with a lit gold fill and no inset. The shaft is a 2px-wide line with no visible volume. The base dome has only 1 light row at x=8 (row 36) and 3 at x=4, and its sides are uniform steps down to dark. Taken together this is a front-elevation lamp, not a clear 3/4 column. When in doubt, fail.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 13 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Its median of 13 colours per tile is below the references' 17 and 20. About 45% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is partly the near-black sticker line. The grey ramp has about 5 steps in clean bands, with little tile-by-tile texture or grain. The 2px pole and the plain dome sides look thinner and flatter than the reference stall and well.
